comment.body: Thanks for confirming the account and restart behavior. The error already extracted from your report says Windows blocked the executable by group policy; that is more specific than a general PowerToys startup failure. Your organization administrator should correlate that launch time with its application-control policy and determine which rule applies to the per-user installation. Please do not disable those protections or change broad folder permissions. The old username/restart questions have been answered, so another generic report archive is not the next useful step.

inferences: The exact denying policy rule remains unidentified; the reporter cannot establish its absence merely because one support team does not intentionally block this application.
